name: Almunajem Foods Company
summary: Almunajem Foods Company, together with its subsidiary, engages in the wholesale and retail trade of fruits, vegetables, cold and frozen poultry and meat, bottled, and food stuff in Saudi Arabia. The company provides poultry and meat; cheese, butter, cream, and evaporated milk; potato, okra, green beans, frozen peas, molokheya, spinach, mixed vegetables, corn, broccoli, and canned vegetables; green, black, greek, and kalamata olives, as well as oil; avocado, acai, mango, pomegranate, guava, strawberry, berries, cherries, and cocktails; rice, cooking oil, thyme, ketchup, mayonnaise, hot sauce, tomato paste, broad beans, and tahina; seafood, shrimp, and fish FPP; chicken, meat, vegetarian, and …
